desc: The Duty series are a full-size 1911 pistol that come from the factory with a long list of features that include a skeletonized hammer and trigger, ambidextrous safety, extended beavertail grip safety and both front/rear slide serrations. This model features a Bobtail frame cut, that minimizes printing and reduces weight when carrying. Built on our forged frame and slide for durability with our cold hammer forged barrels for accuracy, the Duty series is ready for whatever comes at you.
